text: Vaernima, also known as Lady Vaernima, is one of the most consistently "demonic" and "not nice to look at" Daedric Regents. The Regent of corruption, decay, torture, dreams and nightmares, Vaernima is the bearer of evil omens. One of the 16 summonable Daedric Regents of Oblivion, Vaernima's Daedric artifact quest grants the Agent with the Skull of Corruption, an amulet that will create a duplicate of an opponent based on their "darker nature," and have it attack its original form.

Sunnikuse (or “medicine”) is the Bohagande bloodline’s unique ability to direct the hand of Fate, as dangerous as this practice is. Gifted in the art of stealing luck from others, twisting the outcome of situations to their advantage, and even hoarding good fortune, Bohagande are as deadly and feared as any gunslinger of old. They have an uncanny ability to sense the presence or absence of luck in an individual, and use that knowledge for their own good. The unrestrained use of this discipline can have fairly significant consequences, as their aura is not the only reason why Bohagande have a difficult time staying in one place for long. Full descriptions of this discipline and its effects ca

Hydramon is a Vegetation Digimon. It is a gigantic Digimon that mostly takes root in swampland. It constantly secretes a deadly venom from its whole body, which it uses to mercilessly melt and prey upon those that touch it. Also, it has a habit of expelling large amounts of deadly venom from its abdomen, which melts the ground, and creates a swamp to expand its nest. The swamps disturb the surrounding ecosystem, so if you see ominous flowers that have grown abnormally, it is a sign to be cautious. Attacks *: Spews a poison gas from the mouth on its abdomen that has the same components as its deadly venom. *Scatterblaster (): Randomly fires beams from its three heads. *Fault Break (Division B

Pol is a Digimon. Learning by observing Hinukamuy, Jesmon acquired At, Rene, and Pol as part of its ascetic training. They are able to move and act independently under Jesmon's instructions, and boast formidable behavioral abilities such as direct attacks on the enemy, protection of Jesmon, and rescue of other Digimon.

Shansa is a character who appears in the 2017 Disney live-action film Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales. She is a mysterious sea witch who knew the ways of the dark arts and black magic, and often helped people to find information through spells in exchange for a terrifying payment–blood. Her lair and cabin being a crossover of religion, mysticism and magic, yet would feel organic and spiritual.

Wiccan (real name William "Billy" Maximoff) is a character in the Marvel Cinematic Universe who is first featured in the Marvel Disney+ series WandaVision. An alternate version of the character, originating from Earth-838, was featured in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. He is the son of Wanda Maximoff and Vision, and younger twin brother of Tommy Maximoff. He was conceived through the effects of Wanda's chaos magic, which also granted him psionic powers, similar to his mother. Billy was born in Westview, following his mother's accelerated pregnancy, and further aged himself up. As each episode passed, he adapted into a new time period, staring from the 1970s, to the present. Aft

Null Snyper, born Maria Figueroa, is a master Internet troll and an Insatiable Tyrant. She has a natural affinity for networks and technology, and is skilled at manipulating people in online spaces. Through organized campaigns of harassment, Null Snyper drives her targets to suicide or ensures they end up on the wrong end of a swatting. Though she can feed just by watching the bloodshed remotely, she only gains half the normal amount of Satiety; she has not yet eaten any of her victims, but it's only a matter of time. Null Snyper, in the real world, is an emaciated Latina woman with terrible acne and body odor due to her neglect for self-care. Her Horrific form is that of a massive, multi-li
Brokentoe is a clefthoof encountered during the Ring of Blood quest chain. He is immune to stuns and has a poison attack, the power to disorients players, and has a war stomp attack as well.

Bright and deadly ring was either an arcane evocation spell or psionic metacreativity power developed by the amethyst dragon Eldenser, the Worm Who Hides in Blades, to protect himself, the swords he occupied, and their wielders.

Flandal Steelskin () was the gnomish god of mining and smithing, an excellent craftsman with an unerring nose for finding metals in the earth. He was also concerned with the skills of gnomes working as artisans and craftsmen of all kinds.

Nocturnal (in Daedric script, ) is the Daedric Prince whose sphere is the night, darkness and mystery. She is also known as the Night Mistress and Lady Luck. The Cyrodiilic Thieves Guild leader, the Gray Fox, has the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal, which truly represents the sphere's darkness quality; it permanently removes the wearer's specific identity from all history. Regardless, the Cyrodiilic Thieves Guild venerates Nocturnal by ending talks with the saying "Shadow hide you." The summoning date of Nocturnal is 3rd of Hearthfire. Nocturnal and Azura have been referred to as sisters, though whether in the literal or the metaphorical sense is unknown. Nocturnal is sometimes referred to as Ur-Dra,

Virmaril the Betrayer is a powerful Lich boss found inside Skyreach Catacombs. In life he was an Altmer advisor to High King Durac, and friends with his daughter Princess Saradin. Durac married Saradin to Kestic, leading Virmaril to betray him. The Ra Gada were advancing upon the kingdom, and Durac and his council needed a solution. Virmaril met with them under the pretext of providing a solution. Virmaril slaughtered everyone there and enslaved them with necromancy. Nedic soul mages managed to bind him deep underground, though they had to keep watch over him from that point on. Many years later, Scaled Court members disturbed the catacombs, waking Virmaril and allowing him to take over the

The ultimate terrors of the khazra, the members of the Hell Clan possess the abilities of the Night, Blood, and Death clans. Few can stand against them. They are noted for their granite red fur. The Hell Clan has a presence in Aranoch.

Bodaks are what was left of a humanoid that has been destroyed by the touch of pure evil, such as that of a nightwalker. Undead creatures devoid of personality or souls, bodaks are cruel and relentless hunters, either of their own volition or at the behest of some greater power, such as the nightwalker that created them.
Vidar (Old Norse: Viðarr) is the Norse God of Vengeance, Space, Silence and Footwear.
Taishiar was a planeswalker, a recorder, and a far-seer, and servant to Mezlok
Teyo Verada is a human planeswalker shieldmage, or geometrist, from the plane Gobakhan.

Mika Saion's Ability is an unnamed supernatural power, similar to what calls a "gift," featured in the special episode "Kyoka Izumi Will Not Be Silenced." Used by the manga artist Mika Saion, this ability allows her to perfectly mimic, steal, and control the voices of others through the consumption of saliva or tongues. She uses this power to fuel the realistic dialogue of her hit manga series, Midhope.

Tamiyo (; Phyrexian: temDwooD, IPA: [tamʔjoʊʔ]) was a Phyrexian Moonfolk planeswalker from Kamigawa. She was the wife of Genku and the mother of Hiroku, Rumiyo, and Nashi. She was killed by The Wanderer while leading the attack on Kamigawa during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse and returned as an animated story scroll.
Teyo Verada is a human planeswalker shieldmage, or geometrist, from the plane Gobakhan.

Alex Wilder is a Marvel Comics character that appears in the Hulu series Runaways. He ran away from his home and formed the superhero team known as the Runaways alongside other teenagers who ran away from their supervillain parents, protecting the innocent while constantly running away from law enforcement. Alex uses his scientific skills and his high-tech inventions and gadgets to fight crime and the forces of evil. He is also a great leader whom the rest of the team can rely on. Alex Wilder was created by Brian K. Vaughan and Adrian Alphona.

Clyde, also known as Experiment 150, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to be an expert in theft and evasion. He also has advanced lingual skills, enabling him to easily communicate with his partner-in-crime, Bonnie, whom he is programmed to be drawn to. His one true place was originally in Kokaua Town Prison, but he was paroled in "Snafu". After that, it is unknown where his one true place currently is.

The user uses a giant roll of cloth to tightly wrap up the intended opponent, completely immobilising them, thus preventing them from moving or using any techniques. The ability itself is versatile as once completed, the addition of further seals can be placed on top of the bound victims, preventing them from even being summoned while in effect. This technique is used by Sunagakure ninja. Mere physical contact with the cloth seems to be required to use this technique.

is a hero that was created for the pitch meeting for Prometheus, which became Overwatch. Her design is taken from unused Titan concept art. She was later referenced in Overwatch: Declassified - An Official History. She had the following abilities: *Siege Mode *Stationary Shield *Energy Bolt

Sawbones is a unique necromancer located in the Upper Prison. He casts , raises undead, and summons groups of Brittle Thieves that can inflict bleed. The player can use to counter him. Alternatively, player can use or to stop raise undead (and enchanting player minions).

Gilles Grenier is a fictional sorcerer created by Clark Ashton Smith for his short story "The Mandrakes". In the story, Gilles Grenier and his wife Sabine are 15th century sorcerers who move to the French province of Averoigne, where they set up a shop selling love potions made from the roots of mandrakes. Although these potions were their most popular product by far, they also dealt in charms and divination, and Gilles in particular was notable for his ability to "read infallibly the dictates of the stars". He was rumoured to come from a family of werewolves, and his hands and face were singularly hirsute, with a beard that grew almost to his eyes. H. P. Lovecraft established Gilles Grenier

Michel Mauvais was a thirteenth-century French alchemist and black magician in the story "The Alchemist" by H. P. Lovecraft. Michel and his son Charles le Sorcier lived in a cottage on the estates of the Comte Henri de C--. When Henri's young son Godfrey went missing, Michel was blamed due to his evil reputation and was murdered by the wrathful Henri based on nothing more than suspicion. Michel had been killed unjustly, for Godfrey was later found by family servants, alive and wandering in an unused part of the castle. In revenge for the slaying of his father, Charles le Sorcier cursed Henri's entire family line and killed him with lethal poison thrown in his face before escaping into the fo

entity aka "Scholar's Mistress"]] Taffy, also known as The Pale Brown Thing, is a paramental creature brought into being through the focused black magic of Megapolisomancy. Her first appearance is in the horror novella Our Lady of Darkness by Fritz Leiber. Taffy takes its / her physical form from a vaguely woman-shaped piled of old pulp magazines strewn across the protagonist's bed. At the climax of the story the magazines shred themselves into paper dust and form a dry pale brown face figure with a long tangle of dark "hair" and a snout for sucking bone marrow from its victims after it has choked them to death and shattered their bones. Taffy fixates on those who handle or are exposed to a

:Monstructor is a Decepticon combiner in the Generation One continuity family. Beneath the gibbous moons of Cybertron, in the great dark spaces of the sunless void, far beyond the realms of man's childish reachings, does the great dread Monstructor have his origin. A being that seems instinct with some fearful and unnatural malignancy, his form like a robot and a deep great shadow at once, his very presence is said to drain light and life from the world around him, feeding his ancient hunger. A palpable cloak of dread follows his movements, and the very sight of his summoning and formation has driven sane beings beyond the bounds of madness. All living things, mechanical or organic, decay an
Aphrodite is a goddess of love and beauty in the Dodekatheon. Her Scions have Epic Charisma, Epic Manipulation, and Epic Appearance.

Autochthon, the Great Maker, is a Primordial in Exalted. He embodies the ideas of order, technology and science. His physical form contains the otherworldly realm of Autochthonia, which is home to his servants and worshippers (the Autochthonians) as well his his Exalted agents, the Alchemicals.
Lady Eleanor is an Unseelie Sidhe Grump and High Lord of House Leanhaun.
Lady Eithlinn of the Gleaming Eyes is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder and Head of Security for House Balor.

The Father -also revered as the All Judging or the King of Sacrifice, is the Exarch of Prime and one of the four Archigenitors. He grants the Prelacy of Doctrine and his Ministry is the Paternoster. His associated number is three. According to the Seers, the Father is the architect of revealed religion. He communicates through holy visions. He sits on a throne of angels or propels Seers through a dream of hell, filled with symbols representing what the Seer needs to do. He is also one of the only Exarchs with a confirmed gender, and thus is not referred to with the traditional alternating pronouns.
Go Yu-ri is a 13th generation Ventrue art dealer and human trafficker. She is one of several Ready-Made Player Characters found in V20 Ready Made Characters.
Hachiman is the Amatsukami god of fishing, agriculture and war.
Michael Atreides is a Homid Ahroun Bone Gnawer Gatekeeper of the Sept of the Awakening.

Dr. James "Mortius" Howitt is a Tremere stationed within the Milwaukee chantry. Although he is merely an apprentice within the Clan, he has a powerful mentor and Carna, his Regent, is advised to hear him out. The Ashe experiments started as one of Mortius’ trivial hobbies, after he discovered what the Duskborn could do with this drug, but have borne surprising fruit. While his initial studies indicated there may be some resonant force present in vampire remains, the capacity to transfer memories from victim to Ashfinder opened his mind to new possibilities. Ashe, therefore, is a whole new dimension of learning, and the current users are simply test subjects. Mortius is playing the long game

Mordechai Ben-Nun is a occult researcher and performs experiments on both Cainites and Cathayans. He is a respected member of the Sabbat and offers trades for his vast occult knowledge, his mastery of Oblivion or his incredibly potent Vitae if he needs to get what he wants. He uses Detroit as a base for his studies.
Rex is a Malkavian vampire. He resides in Vancouver and is under the protection of the local Nosferatu.

==Overview== A human servant and oracle from a family that has long served the Eastern Black Hand in divining the future and giving advice. These oracles are supposedly in contact with the Djinn from the Realm of Smokeless Fire.
Sir Strallach is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder of House Leanhaun.
Thessalin is a Seelie Selkie Wilder and member of the Rocky Shore Freehold.
Wolfgang is an 11th generation Nosferatu antitribu resident of Berlin. He is a member of the Final Reich Anarch gang, secretly working for the Sabbat.
X is a Malkavian native of Santa Monica, LA. He currently lies in torpor just off the coast of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Venice,_Los_Angeles Venice Beach].

Yor'sahj the Unsleeping calls to the might of Shu'ma, summoning three differently colored globules of his blood. These globules path slowly towards Yor'sahj, infusing him with additional powers if they reach him. When an Acidic Globule reaches Yor'Sahj, the Maw of Shu'ma infuses with the acidic blood and stimulates further Digestive Acid production.

Allavan was a tinker mage. Allavan was well-known for his use of technological devices to aid his arcane casting abilities. He found, through much experimentation, that many of the disadvantages arcane casters suffered could be countered through appropriate use of science. One problem in particular was that if he found himself silenced, he couldn't cast spells with verbal components – that is to say most of his spells. To deal with this eventuality, he developed the voice amplification modulator, a technical device that replicated sounds as a series of vibrations. Although he never perfected the item, he did find that it worked well enough to suit his purposes. He also invented the spellpowe

Arcanist Joraa is a draenei ghost that appears at the Congregation of Souls in Auchindoun while fighting Teron'gor. In life, she was a paragon of order with a passion for order and creation, but Teron'gor corrupts her spirit to gain powers of Destruction.

Beth'Amara was one of the Highborne's most influential alchemists. The wizard alone was said to have mastered transmuting metals among other things. At some point she made Tablet of Beth'Amara and the Rune of Beth'Amara for all of the Highborne of Eldarath to see.

* The Netherese have begun learning magic from the Earlanni elves. * An awesomely powerful sarrukh lich disguises himself as a human archwizard called Arthindol. Arthindol visits the Netherese now and at various points in the coming centuries without apparent age, and teaches them further secrets of arcane magic. They call him "Terraseer" for his ability to see events all around the world.

* Tulan el Akada of Calimport creates a breed of lycanthropic arachnids that can disguise themselves as drow or giant spiders, called the aranea. They are under Tulan's magical control. The aranea prove to be very effective in the war with the drow.
* The wizard Wulgreth, namesake of the Netherese wizard Wulgreth, begins summoning devils in Ascalhorn.
Acwellan was a lich in Myth Drannor, who dwelled in the Mages' Guild.
Adele Astrolara was a sorceress and astrologer who ran the Academy of Stargazers.
Aksa was a famous Netherese arcanist that lived during the Golden Age of Netheril, credited with inventing many basic and advanced spells used in later years.
Aragath Taltar was an evil lich-like undead in Turmish in 1370 DR.

An ashenwight was a form of undead that arose from the bodies of humanoids who had died in areas corrupted by the Far Realm whilst consumed by feelings of cruelty and rage. If specifically arisen near a crystal vein infused with aberrant energies, or if one lingered in an area of fell magic, the ashenwight could potentially develop psionic abilities.
Barghests () were fiendish lupine shapeshifters and the only true natives of Gehenna. They commanded goblinoids and consumed mortal souls to gain power and return to the Fourfold Furnaces.

Beholder zombies were powerful zombies created from the reanimated corpses of dead beholders with the use of necromantic magic. Unlike the despotic death tyrants, they were mindless servants and retained no memory of their living selves.
Bastelli (), also known as dream stalkers or simply as nightmares, where a type of undead nocturnal creatures that fed on dream energies of sleeping folk.
Cthylarr, also known as Cthylarr the Illithilich, was an undead mind flayer from Cyrog as of the late 15 century DR.
Dahlia Vhammos was a vampire and member of the Night Masters, the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks.
Dalanir Ch'fyr was a drow diviner and information broker who operated in Luskan under the pseudonym Soronil Noonshadow.
Darien was a szarkai (albino drow) before Lolth turned her into a albino-drider during the Night of Wailing.

Darkwalker kin were inhabitants of the Moonshae Isles who were believed to be descended from Kazgoroth. They lived with the sensation that their souls were divided into a normal portion and a bestial portion, which did not mesh easily.

Deathlocks were undead spellcasters bound to serve a master. They were usually the remains of warlocks, reanimated by their patrons after failing to fulfill their part of a pact, but could also be created by necromancers.
Death giants and death titans were a race of giants who had powers over shadows and the souls of other beings.
Daxiong was an elven necromancer and inventor who was obsessed with perfecting zombies circa 1372 DR.

Daschnaya was a Vistani halfling with a gift of fortunetelling using the Art and her fortune cards, a member of the merchant caravan led by Katriana that visited such towns of Luruar as Hilltop in the late 14 century DR.
Delacroix was a powerful Netherese arcanist and alchemist who taught at the Alchemical Seminary in Eileanar shortly before its destruction in .
Dhenna Shavres was a Red Wizard and leader of the Rose Keep enclave in Aglarond.

Dhafiyand was a Red Wizard of Thay operating in Neverwinter in the late 15 century DR. He concealed his true allegiance and managed to become the spymaster of the Lord Protector of Neverwinter, Dagult Neverember.
A direhelm was an undead creature created using the foul rituals found in the Codex of Araunt. They were bound to serve their creators, the Eminence of Araunt.
A doomsept was a wraith-like undead creature created using the foul rituals found in the Codex of Araunt. They were bound to serve their creators, the Eminence of Araunt.

Dubilitop was the leader of a group of brownies that were originally nomadic within the Pasocada Basin in Maztica, but settled in Kin Elbhaz. Unknown to the settlement's inhabitants, the brownies took care of the crops and ensured that the area was kept as disease-free as possible, in exchange for taking grain from the store via a secret passage.
Drexlyn Darrowdelve was a dwarf vampire cleric of Abbathor inside Undermountain in 1375 DR.
Duldinbold Alarkyn was a gnome illusionist and high priest of Leira, the Lady of the Mists, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Fadiya al-Farid was a holy slayer and member of the Grey Fire in 1367 DR.
Falious was a Netherese archwizard and the ruler of the Tanathras enclave.

Finder Wyvernspur () was a relatively new deity raised to divinity by acquiring the divine spark of the god Moander. Originally he was a powerful bard named Finder Wyvernspur, though history would recall him as The Nameless Bard. Finder was the demi-power of the cycles of life and the transformation of art. His symbol was a white harp on a gray circle.

Fossil was a remnant of an angel in service to the god Cyric. In 1479 DR, he existed in the form of a sentient mask. He recalled the spirit of Madri from the dead and manipulated her into plotting against the deva Demascus.

Mega Massive Munitions Factory is the Paragon for the Spike Factory , which was first introduced in Version 48.0. It is the second of the Support Monkeys to possess a Paragon, and the tenth Paragon overall. Combining the Super Mines, Carpet Of Spikes, and Perma Spikes, the Mega Massive Munitions Factory is a high-DPS Support category Paragon that lumps explosive damage into its stockpiles and is effective at covering damage across the entire screen. The "power" or degree of the Mega Massive Munitions Factory ranges from 1-100 and is determined by total cost, pop count, tier 5 upgrades, and non-tier 5 upgrades of Spike Factories sacrificed as explained later in the article. As with most Parag

Amani, otherwise known as The Diplomat, is one of the s introduced in Civilization VI: Rise and Fall. She excels at diplomacy with city-states, and is also capable of swaying the Loyalty of others to your favor.
Arniel Gane is a Breton mage and senior member of the College of Winterhold and a researcher of peculiar magics. He wears Adept Robes of Alteration.

Bloodfiends are feral vampires that have gone insane from bloodlust. They are found mainly in the region Rivenspire, but have been seen in other regions, such as Auridon, where they can be found near the town of Phaer. A notable distinction between them and normal vampires is that Bloodfiends will not hesitate to feed upon Corpses. The main questline in Rivenspire also reveals that House Montclair, led by Lady Lleraya Montclair, is hoping to turn the region into Bloodfiends.
Cursed Skull is soul trapped in a skull in . He was enslaved by the necromancers to serve as eyes of Molag Bal. When the skulls are destroyed, he turns into a wraith.

A Doppelganger is a spirit that assumed the guise of their victims and portended certain death. Old witches that come to Daggerfall sometimes tell stories of them. The Doppelganger is mentioned in Mystery of Talara, Book I.

Frostbite Spiders are creatures in . They exist in several varieties and can be found throughout Skyrim's wilderness, as well as inside dungeons and mines (such as Redbelly Mine). They are also one of many arthropods found living in Skyrim. Frostbite Spiders are always aggressive and will attack almost anything on sight, with the exception of Lis. They will spit poisonous venom from afar during combat, which can be harvested and used on weapons after they are killed. Upon attacking, they will make a screeching or scuttling noise. They attack with their mandibles and legs when up close. In addition to their normal melee attacks, all Frostbite Spiders possess a dangerous leaping attack that th

Gheateus, also spelled Gheatus, are a variant of Faerie, or Fey, considered to be godlike beings. According to legend, Gheateus appears as a man, or a group of men, who are formed by the earth, and they are said to be surrounded by a host of minor Sylphim. Gheateus are known to have inhabited Summerset Isles, but are now extinct as they were defeated by the Aldmer in times long past. One of the earliest documented conflicts between Gheateus and Aldmer was during the Aldmeri colonization of Auridon, led by High Lord Torinaan. They are portrayed regularly in sculpture and tapestry in the private collections of the Summerset Isles.
Gravecaller Niramo is a powerful Altmer necromancer in found with his flesh atronach Varien at Reaper's Henge in Reaper's March.
Greywyn Blenwyth was a vampire, and assassin for the Dark Brotherhood. He was the previous occupant of Deepscorn Hollow, and responsible for the facilities and tools the Hero of Kvatch finds inside.

High Kinlord Rilis is an Altmer ghost found in the Banished Cells, in Auridon, Summerset Isles. He is an Altmer revenant of High Kinlord Rilis XII who must be killed to free his soul. In the Banished Cells II, Keeper Cirion united with his soul and turned him into a Xivilai.
Listien Bierles is a Breton residing in Maar Gan. He is a member of the Mages Guild. To show he can be a real sorcerer, he summoned a Scamp. He also sells a number of spells.

Lord Dregas Volar is a unique Dremora Lord. He is the last known user of the Daedric Crescent, and can be found in Magas Volar. Note: The Daedric Crescent causes Paralysis and can melt armors, making this enemy potentially difficult to defeat.
Louic the Red is a Breton vampire member of House Montclair. He is found hiding in a house in Northpoint after Lady Lleraya Montclair is defeated.
Mirkrand is an Altmer sorcerer and vampire who resides in the vampire hideout of Ashmelech.

Movarth Piquine is a master vampire first mentioned in the book Immortal Blood. He later became the leader of a coven in Skyrim, of which Alva and Laelette were members, and functions as the main antagonist during the quest "Laid to Rest."
Moranarg is an Altmer sorcerer and a vampire who resides in the vampire hideout of Ashmelech.

Namira, also spelled Naemira, (Daedric: ), whose sphere is the ancient darkness, is the Daedric Prince of sundry, dark, and shadowy spirits. She is associated with spiders, insects, slugs and other repulsive creatures which inspire mortals with an instinctive revulsion. She is also known as the Mistress of Decay, and the Spirit Daedra. She also is the patron of Tamriel's cannibals, taking pleasure in the consumption of mortals. Namira's plane of Oblivion is known as the Scuttling Void.
Nuzara is a Dark Seducer posing as a friendly Redguard in . She is found at The Manor of Revelry in Coldharbour.

Pergan Asuul is a shadowmage in who has three physical appearances throughout the game. He and Jagar Tharn's interests overlapped during the War of Bend'r-Mahk, where both wanted to capture Skelos Undriel for different reasons. Pergan wanted to in order to gain an advantage in the shadows to summon the in summoning the Umbra' Keth. But Jagar only wanted to have one less enemy to worry about. It is Pergan who summons the creature, and thus is often cited as the main antagonist of the game. He first appears in Twilight Temple, and drops the Twilight Shadowkey. He later appears in Lakvan's Stronghold and attacks once again, but this time it is revealed that his association to Tharn is being str
Rahaja is a vampire found at the Blood Matron's Crypt. She initiates fledgeling vampires into the service of Lamae Bal.
The Ritual Master is an elderly conjurer who can be found in Wolfskull Cave during the quest "The Man Who Cried Wolf" as she is trying to summon the Wolf Queen.
Tancano is the son of Hendil and, because of his vampirism, people in Phaer are turned into mindless thralls, after being fed upon by him. He is killed by the Vestige.

Thane Fellrig is a Dremora in posing as a Nord thane in The Everfull Flagon, a cursed tavern in Coldharbour. A servant of Molag Bal, Fellrig originally tricked the innkeeper Bernt the Brittle and now serves as the tavern's guardian, ensuring the patrons can never leave.
The Shadow King is a Nede spirit found inside the Skyreach Catacombs. He can summon two Shadow Aspects to assist him.
Tragrim is an Altmer sorcerer and vampire who resides in the vampire hideout of Ashmelech.
Trayvond the Redguard is a Redguard Evoker of the Cheydinhal Mages Guild. He sells spells and also studies Mysticism at the Novice level.
Venarus Vulpin is an Imperial vampire in who resides inside Redwater Spring. He is the inventor of Redwater Skooma, and also the author of Venarus Vulpin's Journal and Venarus Vulpin's Research.
Virgar The Red is a Nord vampire residing in Coldharbour. She is the matriarch of The Orchard.

Volanaro is an Altmer and member of the Bruma chapter of the Mages Guild. He has a wide variety of spells for sale and also recharges enchanted artifacts and weapons. He also gives information on the whereabouts of J'skar for the quest "Bruma Recommendation."

Volkihar Vampires are NPCs afflicted with the disease Sanguinare Vampiris. These as with all vampires are classified as undead and are typically found underground in caves or dungeons. But they may be occasionally encountered out in the wilderness of Skyrim during a random encounter.
Wuunferth the Unliving is an elderly Nord mage serving as the court-wizard for Jarl Ulfric Stormcloak. He also teaches Adept-level Destruction magic.

Zalar-do is a Khajiit vampire lord who has made her lair deep inside Hrota Cave. She is responsible for the disappearance of many of Anvil's citizens. Mel Adrys, a famous vampire hunter, has been on her trail for quite a while and can be found outside Hrota Cave, requesting the help of passersby in eliminating her.

The Ghost Knight, also known as the BladeMan or IceWarrior, is an enemy in Final Fantasy IV. It will counter magic attacks on it by casting Reflect on itself, and it will counter physical attacks by casting Bio on a random party member.

Gulgans, also called Gurgans in some fan translations, are sightless sages who foretell the future in Final Fantasy III and live in Gulgan Gulch. They prophesied that mankind would repeat their past mistake of unbalancing the powers of Light and Darkness, leading the world into ruin once more, only for four great Warriors to rise up and set things right. They are central characters, as one gives the Warriors of the Light the White Magic spell, Toad, needed to enter the Tower of Owen, which they predicted was in great danger. Another also provides a hint as to the location of the Fire Crystal, hidden in the land of the dwarves. The Gulgans are likely a reference to Odin from Norse mythology:

The Naakuals are the seven most bloodthirsty hellions that reign over the Ulbuka wilds in Final Fantasy XI: Seekers of Adoulin. Fiercely territorial and short of temper, they have little compassion for pioneers who try to develop these primordial lands. As the Naakuals possess powers greater than many adventurers can even fathom, it stands to reason that the vast majority of layfolk dare not approach them. Even the most foolhardy or valiant of pioneers have yet to lay eyes on all seven. Six of the seven Naakuals may be found protecting the wilds of East Ulbuka, with each Naakual specializing in an element and holding dominion over a specific type of monster. These Naakuals may be found in Wi

is William Tell's Noble Phantasm. The legendary crossbow arrow with which he magnificently pierced the apple put on his son’s head. This arrow that has been shot while receiving the trust of a father’s son will never miss, and will “definitely” pierce the target. This anecdote that has been sublimated as a Noble Phantasm also interferes with the principle of casualty, and is fundamentally impossible to dodge.

(Galactica 1980 1). Mortinson later headed toward Washington, D.C. in the hope of establishing contact with the Colonials, who he correctly surmised to be brothers from the stars. He e
is a former lead singer of the band , having performed alongside Ninny Spangcole. She is also a Watcher and a Dragonclad.

The Hatemonger was a gargantuan amorphous creature, with weirdly shifting skin and tendon-like flesh. From its moist, glistening body, multiple mouths with teeth emerged occasionally, along with half-formed faces and limbs like those of the creatures around it. The mouths produced crying and baying sounds like other various predatory creatures. It had tendril-like tentacles that could grab, pull, and grapple its prey before consuming it. Its movement was described as "slopping" forward.
is a human mage and member of the Sentinels of Memory who infiltrated the Allegiance of Allsight.

Natibe Kurios was an elven rogue and one of the guards at Greyskull Keep. He was a master of spying and infiltration. He was presumed killed after Vox Machina sent him to Wildemount to learn about the Briarwoods. As an NPC, Natibe was played by Matthew Mercer.
Orcus is the Demon Prince of Undeath and the Lord of Necromancy. He is also considered a god of undead, and has a dedicated cult primarily composed of necromancers who do his bidding.

, or Pin for short, is the undead familiar of Occtis Tachonis, made out of parts of foxes. As a familiar, he is controlled by Alexander Ward, with assistance and communication from the Dungeon Master, Brennan Lee Mulligan.
Rauwyn the Trickster was the Shaper of the halflings and a goddess of trickery and fortune in Aramán.

Lolth, the Spider Queen is the evil goddess of deceit, shadows, and spiders. She is known for weaving a complicated web of schemes and treachery through her worshipers, deceiving allies and enemies alike to gain power. Her worship is entwined with the drow society across much of Exandria, and her more diverse followers in Xhorhas seek to punish the drow who turned their back on her in favor of the Luxon.
the Skilled was the Shaper of the dwarves and a goddess of skill and the forge in Aramán.
is a demon of anarchy and destruction exiled in Aramán. As an NPC, she is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Elykris, the Machinist is a Scorn Baron introduced in Destiny 2: Forsaken. Elykris is the second in command of the Scorn Barons. She is well versed in explosive ordinances and weapon crafting. She was imprisoned in the Prison of Elders alongside the other Scorn Barons before being set free.
Aegion, Deductive Mind was a Vex Ultra Hydra in charge of defending and studying the Izanami Forge.

Akelous, the Siren's Current is a Vex Harpy of the Sol Divisive encountered as the first boss of the Spire of the Watcher Dungeon. It is one of the two Sol Divisive minds sent by The Witness to infiltrate the Ares Spire and send it into overload after stealing its data.

Akardon, Pitiless Mind is a Vex Mind of the Sol Divisive that learned how to simulate the Techeuns and their ability to track Riven's clutch. It serves as the final boss of the Starcrossed mission when the Guardian goes into the Black Garden to retrieve one of Riven's Eggs.

Brandaks Reborn is the remade version of Brandaks Prime, one of the major Prime Servitors of the House of Dusk, Upon death, Brandaks will split into four Teleks-8s which will then split into four Merix-6s, leading to a battle against sixteen Servitors.

Deceived Abominations are Major Scorn Abominations that were lured by Drifter to compete in games of Gambit. They appear in advanced waves, using their power to halt the progress of the team. They drop five Motes of Dark upon death.

Emperor Calus was the former Emperor of the Cabal. After overthrowing the ruling Praetorate, he reigned the Cabal Empire for over a thousand years until he was overthrown himself in a coup led by Dominus Ghaul and exiled to aimlessly wander the galaxy aboard the Leviathan. It was there he first encountered the Witness who enabled him to take control of his fate. Following Ghaul’s death in the Red War, Calus traveled to the Sol System to scout the Young Wolf and their fellow Guardians as his future Shadows to have by his side as he prepared for the coming of the Black Fleet and what he believed to be the end of all things. After the Black Fleet returned to the Sol System, he communed with the

Ir Sûfra, Third Aria is a Hidden Swarm Deathsinger seen in the Choir of the Damned Mission, where the Wizard along with her coven and leader, Ir Airâm, Deathsinger, would be hunted and killed by The Guardian to gather their essence in hopes of creating the Deathbringer.

Kudazad, Binder of Savathûn was a Hive Wizard in service of Savathûn, the Witch Queen who was stationed on the moon Titan before being defeated by Guardians. Years after her death, following Titan being abducted by The Witness, her skull would be recovered by Kelgorath, Risen from Bones and used in a ritual to both offer his tributes to Xivu Arath and to bring the Wizard back to life, giving her the new title Bound to Xivu Arath. She would be used to disrupt Vanguard recovery operations in the deep ocean of Titan until they were slain by The Guardian.

Macheus, Cryptographic Mind is a Vex Mind of the Nessian Schism tasked with sorting data and erasing unwanted strands. It is encountered as one of the four Secret Strangelet Capsule-guarding world bosses of The Edge of Fate's Mythic difficulty campaign.

The Nightmare of Taniks, the Scarred is the Nightmare form of the infamous Fallen mercenary and murderer: Taniks, the Scarred. Recreated with the power of the Darkness by the Lunar Pyramid, it serves as the Aspect of Isolation.
Ritualists of Xivu Arath are powerful Hive Wizards employed by Xivu Arath, God of War for a number of rituals.
Subjugators are powerful Dread commanders that serve the Witness; utilizing the Darkness powers of Stasis and Strand at their disposal.

Illusion Weavers are the deadliest breed of the Hidden in Diablo I. In addition to the abilities of their lesser kin, Illusion Weavers are resistant to both magic and fire. Also, unlike their lesser kin, Illusion Weavers cannot be hit when they once more cloak themselves and move away after being wounded. These various abilities make them deadly and unpredictable foes. They are the only Hidden variant which can be found in the Caves.
The Lacuni Hunter is a type of lacuni monster in Diablo Immortal. It attacks via thrown spears, and nets to Immobilize prey.

Maltorius was a Master Necromancer. In an unparalleled display of summoning prowess, he raised the tallest Golem in history. However, the record was lost when the spike at the top of the Golem was cut from it.

The is the Immortal that is in charge of distribution of commendations to members of the Immortals based on their participation and contribution. He is also in charge of expedition to discovered Corvus structures in search of knowledge and treasure. Of note, he led the excavation that took place at the Bygone Islet.

Enmamon is a Demon Lord Digimon. It is one of the Tentei Hachibushu, and rules over Yomi. Its familiars Zenzu and Akuzu inscribe DigiCore information onto scrolls for Enmamon to examine. Should a DigiCore be determined to contain a bug, that DigiCore is confined within Yomi, never to be reincarnated. Enmamon's word dictates the laws of Yomi, and it rules with an iron fist, punishing those who attempt to escape. Yet, it too is also bound by the same system, unable to ascend to the outside world. It possesses a mirror capable of reflecting all attacks named the , which makes defeating Enmamon in Yomi impossible. Attacks *Mirror of Retribution *: Swings its ritual baton downward to conjure a gi

Ficusmon is a Parasite Digimon. It ensnares other Digimon with its tree-like tentacles to infest and control them. Once parasitized, the host Digimon is forced to fight with reckless abandon, becoming much more aggressive at the cost of sustaining more injuries, thus decreasing its lifespan. Furthermore, when the host Digimon succumbs to its injuries, Ficusmon forcibly rewrites the remaining data in a way that ensures a Parasite Digimon of the same lineage is born. This behavior is how a Ficusmon propagates. After losing a host, it will begin searching for its next target. It is rare for a Ficusmon to fight on its own. Its only means of attack is "Armed Tendril". Attacks *Armed Tendril: Shap

Gigimon is a Lesser Digimon. It is a four-legged Digimon that grew from Jyarimon. Its physical features resemble those of Tokomon, and there are powerful fangs growing within its mouth. However, unlike Tokomon, who digivolves into the Mammal-species, Gigimon, who digivolves into the Dragon-species, has a rough personality, and is ferocious despite its small size. There are more than a few even larger Digimon that were deceived by its appearance and suffered a counterattack. The temperature of its bites are hot like with Jyarimon. Attacks *Hot Bite: Snaps at the opponent, burning the things it bites. *: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Kakeimon is a Account Book Appmon. An Appmon who excels at bargain shopping and conversation. When it comes to purchasing products at the cheapest possible price, no other Appmon can match it. Attacks *Thrifty Heart (Setsuyaku Heart) *Stingy Heart (Kechikechi Heart)

Moneymon is an eMoney Appmon. An Appmon with the ability to withdraw money from a target. If you ask it for a loan, you can temporarily obtain an amount that exceeds the amount of money that you have. Attacks *Roulette Bank *Money Shock

Recomon is a Recording Appmon. An Appmon with the ability to record the sounds and words of its targets. It is a very meticulous Appmon, and will immediately record even conversations that are not particularly important. Attacks *Absorbing Interview (Absorb Interview) *Slack Mic

Sandmon is a Slime Digimon. Its body is made of sand. It has an aggressive personality despite being a Fresh, and is strongly territorial. It has an amorphous body which can disperse like sand or conversely harden like clay, but its pacifier alone is unable to change shape in any way. When opponents approach it throws a lot of sand to intimidate them. Attacks *: Throws a lot of sand to intimidate approaching opponents.

Rootmon is a Parasite Digimon. It is a peculiar Digimon that grows by parasitizing other Digimon with its root-like tentacles and claws. Because Rootmon can only leech small amounts of data at a time, large Digimon rarely ever realize they've been infested. Due to this unusual behavior, a proper method of training it has yet to be developed. Attacks *Entwine: Uses its constricting tentacles to suffocate the life from foes with unexpected strength for a Fresh Digimon.

Savemon is a Backup Appmon. An Appmon with the ability to create and save backups of data. With this backup, it can restore the target's state to a previous state. Attacks *Saving Bubble *Split Memory

Setmon is a Setup Appmon. An Appmon that can set up even the most difficult-to-use precision equipment so that it can be used right away. The manuals it creates are very easy to understand, even for beginners. Attacks *Quick Setup *Peaky Settings (Peaky Setting)

Kurata Akihiro is the main antagonist of Digimon Savers. =Profile= Kurata Akihiro is a notorious professor and the main antagonist of Digimon Savers; nearly everything that happens in the series, including the Royal Knight's later attack against humanity, can be traced directly to him. He was one of the people who went on the exploration to the Digital World, along with Satsuma Rentarou and Daimon Suguru. =Personality= Kurata is extremely bitter, despicable and cowardly, seeing Digimon as a menace and seeks to destroy them mercilessly over a petty grudge. Despite his general cowardice and pettiness, he is as dangerous as he is intelligent and competent, being a skilled manipulator, liar and

were genetically altered Dogs made by the Bene Tleilax, originally for Malina Aru (leader of CHOAM). Her two spinehounds were named Har and Kar. They were said to have razor sharp spines for fur that would lacerate all who did not pet them in the correct manner. They were also blood bound to their owners and extremely vicious.

Bahamut is the draconic god of protection and good fortune. It is also the name of a constellation in the skies of Eberron. Like all dragon deities apart from the overlord Tiamat, his existence is a matter of faith, not of fact.
Baron Dalin d'Vadalis is the patriarch of House Vadalis. He is renowned for his skill in breeding animals and befriending people.

Living spells are deadly horrors that haunt the Mournlands, the cursed remains of the great nation of Cyre. These monstrosities at first appear to be lingering conjurations, but they have no external guidance—these spells have a life of their own. living spells are not a natural form of life. They have no need for self-preservation, and communicating with these creatures is nearly impossible. They have no earthly needs: They don't eat, sleep, or reproduce. When encountered, living spells immediately attack. Just like the destructive nature of an attack spell, a living spell is simply fulfilling the direction provided by its arcane instinct.

Fenris, also known as the goddess of shadow, is the main antagonist in Fire Emblem Shadows. She is said to be capable of granting any wish, but the price for having one's wish granted is to give themselves to the shadows.

Yune is a non-playable character from Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn. She is the Goddess of Chaos, and one half of Ashunera, the other being Ashera. She is also the small orange bird Micaiah owns, and Yune speaks to her in this form before Micaiah sings the Galdr of Release. If the chaos of war forced her to awake, then Ashera would also awake and pass her judgment upon the world. But, if the Galdr of Release awoke her, then Ashera would have to speak to Yune first before passing her judgment. Unfortunately, Ashera broke this agreement and turned most of Tellius' inhabitants into stone. After Micaiah sang the Galdr of Release, Yune possesses Micaiah to talk to the mortals who would lead her army
Zagreus (Greek: Ζαγρεύς) is the Olympian God of Rebirth. He is the second child of Zeus and Demeter, and brother of Persephone.
Arzakon was a powerful planeswalker from an unknown plane who tried to take control over Shandalar.
Arvad is a vampire, who once was a Benalish knight. He became security chief of Jhoira's crew on the rebuilt Skyship Weatherlight.
Bozak is an undead fungal kraul and servant of Mazirek, part of the Golgari Swarm on the plane of Ravnica.
Cayth is a famous dwarf artificer and mechanist from an unknown plane. She is able to create and upgrade Servos.
Cordelia is a vampire of the Stromkirk lineage of Nephalia on the plane of Innistrad.
Dovin Baan was a vedalken planeswalker from Avishkar. He was an artificer and a system's mage.
Draktha was a manipulative green-skinned mage who practiced black magic.

Endrek Sahr (EHN-drek SAHR) was a wizard affiliated with the Order of the Ebon Hand in Dominarian Sarpadia. Styling himself "Creator of Life and Race Architect", Sahr was responsible for creating the first thrulls as servants and objects of sacrifice for the Order.

Felisa Fang is a vampire wizard student at the Silverquill College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios. She is called Fang of the Silverquill which is a play on her last name. She is a Vainglory, a Silverquill mage that uses words to inspire or reproach their target.

Born in Bant, Alara, Gwafa Hazid is a master merchant and leader of the Grand Caravan who was influenced by Nicol Bolas into spreading rumors and swindling his fellow citizens whenever he can get away with it and spreading xenophobia.

Gideon Jura, born Kytheon Iora (KITH-ee-un ee-OR-uh), was a hieromancer and planeswalker beholden to the multiplanar coalition known as the Gatewatch. Affectionately called Gids by Chandra Nalaar and called Beefslab by Liliana Vess.

Hurkyl was a Master Wizard as well as one of the founders of the College of Lat-Nam and the Union of the Third Path during the Brothers' War on Dominaria. She was the wife of Drafna and played a major part in rediscovering magic on Terisiare.
Lord Ith was a powerful wizard during the post-Brothers' War period on Terisiare (Dominaria). He was leader of the Conclave of Mages.

Jared Carthalion, also known as the Shadow Mage, is a member of the long and illustrious Carthalion lineage, dating back far into the Ice Age. He is a planeswalker from Dominaria with the powers of a Ley Druid and an Elder Druid.
Isona Maive is a human planeswalker from Aykan whose specialty is prismatic magic, amplifying the magic of others.
Ilvoro was a merfolk lullmage mentor of Halimar with a Stonework Puma familiar who hired himself out as a guide across the Teeth of Akoum.
Kasmina is a human planeswalker from Antausia, introduced in War of the Spark. She uses transformation and control spells.
Johann is a Human wizard boy from Eldraine. He is the apprentice of the archmage Gadwick.
Dr. Ludevic of Ulm is a wheezing and reclusive necro-alchemist, and the most influential of Innistrad's merchants.

Sash and Waistcoat were two of six unmen created by Ixidor in Otaria on Dominaria. They were known as troublemakers. Un-men are a creation of Ixidor derrived from his shadow using dementia magic that served as living escape portals designed to seal themselves when both their creator and his remaining un-men had passed through closing the escape route. Upon this usage the un-man would cease to exist. Ixidor created six un-men and while evading death used four of the portals. An issue persisted during the fourth escape attempt in that two of the un-men, who called themselves Sash and Waistcoat, decided they would very much like to not die and abandoned their creator causing the final un-man, l

Sevinne is a human chronarch from Dominaria with a taste for adventure and a love of exploration. After being trained at the Tolarian Academy in temporal magic, he grew restless with book learning and left to roam the world as soon as he had gained his wizard's mantle. As a gifted sorcerer with an encyclopedic knowledge of the arcane arts, he relies on his magical prowess to aid him in his escapades across Dominaria.
Sorin Markov is a vampire planeswalker and a master of sangromancy, a dark corner of black mana specialization.
Tormod, the Desecrator, is a lich from the Dark Age on Dominaria.
Timothar Markov is a vampire noble from Innistrad belonging to the Markov bloodline.
Vaylesh, known as the Ebon Hand Priestess, was a high priestess in the Order of the Ebon Hand on Sarpadia (Dominaria).

Umori, the Collector is a legendary ooze from the plane of Ikoria. According to Vivien Reid's studies, Umori harvests the crystals that dot Ikoria and sticks them into its body as a form of decoration. While the crystals stop glowing when picked, Umori can make them glow in batches on command, creating a natural light show. Umori fought in defense of Ikoria during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.
Dean Valentin is a vampire warlock teacher at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.

Lord Windgrace was a panther warrior planeswalker from Urborg on Dominaria. He was one of the Nine Titans that Urza gathered to fight Phyrexia. After his death, he became a protective Avatar of Urborg.
Doctor Zlovol was a Simic viromancer from Ravnica, who performed unethical experiments regarding the spread of dangerous diseases.

A Key Mind is an exceptionally advanced form of the Flood. Several were formulated during the Forerunner-Flood war to combat the Forerunners with pure strategic might. The use of Precursor technology gave each Key Mind incredible processing power and strategic skill that easily matched that of a Metarch-level Ancilla, such as Mendicant Bias or Offensive Bias. Being a compound, distributed intelligence, each Key Mind was an extremely large and well-developed instance of the Gravemind entity. These enormous collective consciousness composed the leadership of the Flood, coordinating their efforts throughout their war with the Forerunners. Each new instance added to the overall Gravemind's intel
Genemender Folder of Fortune was a Forerunner Lifeworker who lived during the Forerunner-Flood war. At the end of the war they were composed and their mind was used to create a , Adjutant Vigilance.

is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders. An infamous Native American shaman and assassin in DIO's service, Devo ambushes Jean Pierre Polnareff in his hotel room in Singapore. He is a Stand User and uses Ebony Devil.

This unnamed Stand possessed by Vinegar Doppio is featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. The Stand allows Doppio to turn standard objects into cellphones for long-distance communication, which anybody can use.
The was one of a trio of demons who impersonated Buddhas to steal fragrant oil from Gold Average Prefecture.
Adrasteia is one of the three spinning fates of Theros, responsible for cutting the threads of mortals whose lives have finished to keep order in the tapestry as a whole.
Ariosa is a villager of Lambholt on the plane of Innistrad. She also appears to be an occultist involved in the summoning of Old Stickfingers.

Arinos was a farmer from Lambholt on the plane of Innistrad, who was involved in the summoning of Old Stickfingers. Although his village assumes him to have died, it may rather be that his body is possessed by Old Stickfingers, who is supposedly able to "wear skins".
Arzakon was a powerful planeswalker from an unknown plane who tried to take control over Shandalar.

Azor is a sphinx of unknown origin and a former planeswalker. He is a lawmage and a hieromancer and sees himself as the Arbiter of Law. On Ravnica, he is remembered as Supreme Judge Azor I or First Judge Azorius and the parun of the Azorius Senate. On Ixalan, he is known as the legendary Last Guardian of the Immortal Sun.
B.O.B, the Bevy of Beebles, is a planeswalker who is composed of a bevy of Beebles.
Azamuki (ah-zah-MOO-kee), Treachery Incarnate, is a kami of treachery on Kamigawa that resides inside and influences people.
Baas is a one-armed ogre shaman and tattoo artist, part of the Ghor clan of Gruul.
Bozak is an undead fungal kraul and servant of Mazirek, part of the Golgari Swarm on the plane of Ravnica.
Cayth is a famous dwarf artificer and mechanist from an unknown plane. She is able to create and upgrade Servos.
Cormela, Glamour Thief is a vampire rogue of the Maestros family in New Capenna.
Cordelia is a vampire of the Stromkirk lineage of Nephalia on the plane of Innistrad.
Elenda of Garrano, also known as the first vampire, the Dusk Rose or Black Rose, and Saint Elenda the Venerable is the legendary ancestor of the vampires of the Legion of Dusk on Ixalan.
Egon is the god of death from Kaldheim. When attempting to enter Starnheim, he disguised himself as the human Bjorn.
Eris is an elemental warlock who arrived on Thunder Junction after the opening of the Omenpaths.
Haakon was the undead leader of the Order of Stromgald in Terisiare and lord of Tresserhorn.
Horobi (hoh-ROH-bee), Death's Wail, is a kami of death from Kamigawa.
Jeleva is a vampire wizard that lives in the Nephalia region of Innistrad.
Isona Maive is a human planeswalker from Aykan whose specialty is prismatic magic, amplifying the magic of others.
The Lord of Tresserhorn, was an undead replacement for Lim-Dûl, created by Chaeska after Lim-Dûl's Battle.
Massacre Girl is an anonymous Rakdos spiker gang leader and assassin from Ravnica who leaves a trail of terror and murder wherever she goes.
Malik, Grim Manipulator, is a legendary human rogue from Innistrad.
Mannichi (man-NEE-chee) is a kami from Kamigawa, the mischievous, strange little spirit of fevers and hallucinations.

Nailah (NAY-la) was a powerful Sorceress Queen of Rabiah, who sought to force the Unification of Taysir and then absorb Taysir's power. While most people on Rabiah have one thousand and one versions, one for each copy of Rabiah, Taysir only had five, one for each type of magic. The prophecy had it that if the five were united, they would become the strongest planeswalker ever.

Nhillosh is a vedalken Azorius senator from Ravnica As a legislator and a prosecutorial lawmage, he was present during Agrus Kos' promotion hearing. After the War of the Spark he acted as second in command to Grand Arbiter Pro Tem Lavinia.
Taishiar was a planeswalker, a recorder, and a far-seer, and servant to Mezlok

Suniel the Woodwise is an Selesnyan druid and woodshaper on the plane of Ravnica. He sits on the council of high priests of the Conclave, along with Molander, Troslon, Alcarus, and Sadruna, and is famous for having been directly responsible for the creation of the three-dryad unity known as Trostani.
Tormod, the Desecrator, is a lich from the Dark Age on Dominaria.

Tymaret, known by the humans of Theros as The Murder King, is an undead warrior and the de facto leader of Odunos, the polis inhabited by the more violent Returned who have escaped the clutches of the plane's Underworld and its God Erebos. Tymaret commands its best warriors in organized raids against the living. Their raids are small but effective, and almost always nocturnal.
Dean Valentin is a vampire warlock teacher at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
Vadmir is a vampire rogue from an unknown plane who arrived on Thunder Junction after the Omenpaths opened.

Lord Windgrace was a panther warrior planeswalker from Urborg on Dominaria. He was one of the Nine Titans that Urza gathered to fight Phyrexia. After his death, he became a protective Avatar of Urborg.
Zur, known as Zur the Enchanter or as Zur the Mad, is a powerful wizard, prominent during the Dominarian Ice Age.
Doctor Zlovol was a Simic viromancer from Ravnica, who performed unethical experiments regarding the spread of dangerous diseases.
Nazar, also known as the Velvet Fang, is a vampire warlock from an unknown plane.
Primo is a legendary fractal wolf created by Zimone Wola that only appears in prime numbers.

Angelica, also known as Angelica Rivera or Angelica Teach, is the secondary antagonist and anti-heroine of Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides. She is an old flame of Jack Sparrow, as well as the daughter of the ruthless Blackbeard, the pirate all pirates feared. Sharp-witted and beautiful, Angelica has a talent to dazzle and deceive, a master of disguises. She learned the art of con from Jack Sparrow himself, with Angelica possibly being the only woman Jack ever truly loved. During the quest for the fabled Fountain of Youth, Angelica served as first mate aboard the Queen Anne's Revenge with the goal to save Blackbeard's soul.

Anubis is the ancient Egyptian god of the dead, associated with the afterlife and mummification. Anubis is depicted as a humanoid with the head of a jackal. In the public domain, he is often considered a psychopomp, similar to The Grim Reaper. In Gargoyles, he is also one of the Children of Oberon.
Barry is a minor antagonist that appears in the 2019 Disney Channel animated series Amphibia. He is a devious frog man that specializes in the dark arts of magic curses.
Isaac Heller, also known as The Author, is a character of Once Upon a Time. He was the author of the Once Upon a Time book until the quill chose Henry Mills to take over the job.

Lyria is the best story-telling fairy in all of Pixie Hollow. She tells magical tales at Fairy Tale Theater, which she brings to life by creating moving illustrations out of pixie dust. Whenever a show happens, many gather around. Fairy Mary is especially a big fan - she never misses a performance. After a long show, Lyria drinks special tea to clear her voice. Even though she's brave on stage, she can be quite shy with her friends. Her greatest wish is to travel to the mainland and see a human play. Only her closest friends know this.

Paladin is a Marvel Comics character that appears in VisionQuest, played by Todd Stashwick. Paladin is a mercenary. He has no powers, but he is an expert at hand-to-hand combat and an excellent marksman. Paladin was created by Jim Shooter and Carmine Infantino.

Poxy, also known as Experiment 222, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to act as a virus and infect popular planetary leaders, giving them purple pimples, smelly feet, a swollen right eye, and uncontrollable burping; the symptoms vanish instantly when Poxy leaves his host. He was captured by Gantu (whom he temporarily infected), but was rescued in "Snafu". According to a DVD bonus feature game in Lilo & Stitch 2: Stitch Has a Glitch, his one true place is fixing health issues.

The Scarlet Witch (real name Wanda Maximoff) is a Marvel Comics character who has appeared in many Marvel-related productions. She was introduced in the Marvel Cinematic Universe as a cameo in the mid-credits scene of Captain America: The Winter Soldier. Wanda is the twin sister of Pietro Maximoff, alias Quicksilver. She started out as a vengeful lackey to the evil Ultron, before redeeming herself and joining the Avengers following the death of her brother, who would have done likewise if he had lived. Spider-Man (real name Peter Benjamin Parker) is a superhero from Marvel Comics and one of Marvel's most well-known superheroes. Spider-Man has appeared in countless media since his debut in 1962's Amazing Fantasy #15. Peter Parker was an unpopular high school student who was bitten by a genetically altered radioactive spider that granted him spider-like superpowers. However, due to the death of his uncle Ben Parker or his aunt May Parker, Peter vowed to use his powers responsibly and for good, becoming the superhero known as Spider-Man. However, Mr. Incredible had no interest in such a concept and considered it risky behavior. To take revenge on Mr. Incredible, he became a supervillain and devoted his life to his vendetta. Tia Dalma is a major character from the Pirates of the Caribbean film series, who first appeared in Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest. She is a soothsayer and Caribbean priestess who is the mortal guise of the sea goddess, Calypso. Additionally, Tia is a practitioner of voodoo and the dark arts who resided and hid away in the resistible swamps of the Pantano River in Cuba.
